# High-Risk Checklist

Use this template when the ticket touches security, data, contracts, or
external systems.

## Risk Flags

- auth or authorization
- data model or migration
- public API or integration contract
- external provider or dependency
- weak existing proof

## Required Checks

- impacted boundary is identified
- rollback or containment is defined
- validation includes targeted proof
- residual risk is stated explicitly
